target_customer: Product, design and engineering teams that turn Figma, Sketch or XD designs and websites into front-end code, later also AI coding agents through an API
problem: Handing designs to developers is slow and manual, and developers rebuild the UI by hand from design files.
business_model: SaaS subscriptions for design-to-code plugins and platform, plus an API used by AI app builders

founders.name: Avishay Cohen
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch July 2018 says Arbel met the Cohens at Ben-Gurion University and that the Cohens had finished military service. Listed as Founder and CEO on the YC page.

founders.name: Michal Cohen
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in TechCrunch 2018 and the YC page.

founders.name: Or Arbel
previous_startups: Yo, messaging app he founded, wound down about two years before July 2018
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in TechCrunch 2018 and 2021 and as CTO in tech.eu 2020; not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: InVision
competitors.what: Design collaboration and handoff products including design to code handoff

technical_complexity.rationale: Plugins that parse design files and generate responsive, readable code in several frameworks need real engineering, but ran on public plugin APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Depended on Sketch and later Figma plugin platforms where the platform owners and rivals could add similar export features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sketch support was later scaled back as Figma took over, and Anima moved to Figma and later AI agents; IBM invested in February 2026 per its homepage headline.

market_need_then: In 2018 Anima reported about 100,000 users and several thousand paying customers while profitable, which TechCrunch cited as evidence designers and developers wanted automated handoff.

identity.voice_and_tone: Product-team focused, vision language such as delivering the best version of their vision

branding.brand_signature: The Figma plugin installs figure and Product Hunt launches
branding.community_and_virality: Homepage cites 1.8M builders and a quote from Bolt's CEO calling it a top Figma extension; Product Hunt launches; self-reported.

brand_strength.rationale: Known among designers and developers through plugin installs and AI builders using its engine, but the name is shared with unrelated companies and no mascot or origin story was found.

pivots.to: Figma and multi-tool design to code platform
pivots.why: Support site says Sketch support was removed due to the market shifting toward Figma; exact date not given

outcome_analysis: Anima was bootstrapped and profitable with about 100,000 users before YC in 2018, built on Sketch plugins. It raised a 2.5 million dollar seed in 2020 and a 10 million dollar Series A in 2021 as it moved to Figma, and now supplies design to code to AI app builders. It is active, with an IBM investment headline in 2026 and no acquisition or shutdown found.
notes: Dealroom total of 12.6 million and Welcome to the Jungle total of 15.7 million both come from aggregators and conflict, so unverified; the 2026 IBM investment amount is undisclosed and only seen as a homepage headline and a search snippet, so it is not recorded as a round. Series A article does not mention the seed, and says Anima was bootstrapped until 2020. Outcome search returned no news about Anima itself. Michal Cohen is COO on YC page and CPO in tech.eu.
